-- 固定语料：每个来源 10 篇，按 md5(url) 排序保证可重复
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT n.source_key,
           n.title,
           j.raw_content AS data,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY n.source_key ORDER BY md5(n.url)) AS rn
    FROM public.tech_news n
    JOIN public.jina_raw_logs j ON j.url = n.url
    WHERE n.title IS NOT NULL
      AND BTRIM(n.title) <> ''
      AND j.raw_content IS NOT NULL
      AND length(j.raw_content) > 200
)
SELECT source_key, title, data
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 10
ORDER BY source_key, rn;
